title: Signal
description: Anything that arrived: a bug report, a feature request, an idea, a failing test (design part 3.2). Created by intake, updated by triage. In the files backend the body is the file's text below the front matter.

source.description: Intake adapter ID and channel, for example github-issues:owner/repo.

external_ref.description: The source's own reference: a URL or message ID.

author.description: Contributor ID if known; otherwise the source's handle.

body.description: Verbatim, stored where its classification allows.

summary.description: One or two sentences written by the quarantined normalizer.

route.description: Set by triage: auto-fix, backlog, owner, reply, or "closed: <reason>". Null until triaged.

links.description: Items, opportunities and decisions created from it.

provenance.description: Ordered transforms: who or what touched it and how, with dispatch IDs.

design_refs.description: Design sections that already cover the signal, or relate to it.
